detail.title: KM500 RGB Keyboard & Mouse Combo - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports KM500 pairs a brushed-aluminium finish keyboard with per-key backlit double-shot ABS keycaps and a 6D optical mouse, delivering a complete gaming setup in one affordable combo. The keyboard's reinforced aluminium plate prevents warping over time, while a comfortable anti-slip rubberized mouse coating paired with a highly sensitive optical sensor makes for precise, comfortable control. A dedicated DPI toggle button switches between 800 and 3200 DPI to suit different gaming genres and productivity tasks, and integrated wrist support on the keyboard keeps hands comfortable during long sessions. True plug-and-play compatibility spans Windows and Mac, with no extra software required.
